schema_sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS accounts (id INT PRIMARY KEY, name NVARCHAR(255), category NVARCHAR(50), created_at DATETIME2)
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS notifications (id INT PRIMARY KEY, account_id INT, notified_at DATETIME2, payload NVARCHAR(MAX), FOREIGN KEY (account_id) REFERENCES accounts(id))
generation_sql: INSERT INTO accounts (id, name, category, created_at) SELECT n, CONCAT('Account_', n), CASE WHEN n % 4 = 0 THEN 'large' ELSE 'small' END, DATEADD(DAY, -n, GETDATE()) FROM (SELECT TOP {row_count} ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY (SELECT NULL)) AS n FROM sys.all_objects) AS numbers

INSERT INTO notifications (id, account_id, notified_at, payload) SELECT n, 1 + (n % 100), DATEADD(MINUTE, -n, GETDATE()), REPLICATE('A', 1000) FROM (SELECT TOP {row_count} ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY (SELECT NULL)) AS n FROM sys.all_objects) AS numbers
